records.source: It's a myth that rainy weather causes the flu. However, take care that you don't slip on the mud!#$e#I often worry about you.
records.translation: Isang mito na nagdudulot ng trangkaso ang maulang panahon. Gayunman, mag-ingat kang huwag madulas sa putik!#$e#Madalas akong mag-alala sa iyo.

records.source: It was so incredibly lonely living above the clinic by myself... I'm much happier now.$h
records.translation: Napakatindi ng lungkot nang mag-isa akong nakatira sa itaas ng klinika... Di-hamak na mas masaya ako ngayon.$h

records.source: I woke up early, but I made sure not to wake you. You looked so peaceful.
records.translation: Maaga akong nagising, pero tiniyak kong hindi kita ginising. Napakapayapa ng hitsura mo.

records.source: I don't mind the rain. Sure, I can't watch the planes go by, but I can still listen to the radio chatter.#$e#It makes the whole thing a little more mysterious.
records.translation: Ayos lang sa akin ang ulan. Totoo, hindi ko mapapanood ang pagdaan ng mga eroplano, pero mapakikinggan ko pa rin ang usapan sa radyo.#$e#Dahil dito, medyo mas mahiwaga ang lahat.

records.source: I have a backlog of house chores I want to complete today. I've got plenty to keep me busy!
records.translation: Marami akong naipong gawaing-bahay na gusto kong tapusin ngayon. Marami akong mapagkakaabalahan!

records.source: How was your day, honey? I was going to do the dishes but I got absorbed in the latest issue of "Knee Surgery Enthusiast".
records.translation: Kumusta ang araw mo, mahal? Maghuhugas sana ako ng mga pinggan pero lubos akong naaliw sa pinakabagong isyu ng “Mahilig sa Operasyon ng Tuhod”.

records.source: You know, this 'journal of tendon dynamics' is actually bearable when I'm reading out here.
records.translation: Alam mo, matitiis naman pala ang “Dyornal ng Dinamika ng Litid” kapag binabasa ko rito sa labas.

records.source: If you're enjoying life, who cares if it's a little repetitive? That's what I say.
records.translation: Kung nasisiyahan ka sa buhay, sino ang may pakialam kung medyo paulit-ulit ito? Iyan ang sabi ko.

records.source: You look a little soggy, hun. Why don't you warm yourself by the fire?^You look a little soggy, dear. Why don't you warm yourself by the fire?
records.translation: Mukhang medyo basâ ka, mahal. Bakit hindi ka magpainit sa tabi ng apoy?^Mukhang medyo basang-basa ka, mahal ko. Bakit hindi ka magpainit sa tabi ng apoy?

records.source: The sound of rain gives our minds something to focus on, so we're not distracted by random thoughts.#$e#That's my theory for why it's so soothing...
records.translation: Binibigyan ng tunog ng ulan ang isip natin ng matutuunan, kaya hindi tayo ginugulo ng mga ligaw na kaisipan.#$e#Iyan ang teorya ko kung bakit napakapanatag nito...

records.source: I made us a nice healthy dinner. Only fresh, wholesome ingredients from the valley! [212 214 225 209 200]$h#$e#Just make sure to eat a reasonable portion, dear.
records.translation: Naghanda ako ng masarap at masustansiyang hapunan para sa atin. Pawang sariwa at masustansiyang sangkap mula sa lambak! [212 214 225 209 200]$h#$e#Tiyakin mo lang na katamtaman ang dami ng kakainin mo, mahal.

records.source: I think we're all striving to reach some kind of balance in life. An equilibrium of complexity.#$e#For me, moving here was exactly what my body needed to find that balance.$l
records.translation: Sa tingin ko, lahat tayo ay nagsisikap makamit ang isang uri ng balanse sa buhay. Isang balanse sa gitna ng kasalimuotan.#$e#Para sa akin, ang paglipat dito mismo ang kailangan ng katawan ko upang matagpuan ang balanseng iyon.$l

records.source: Good morning, @! I made you a nutritious breakfast.[201]#$e#Eggs are a good source of essential nutrients, so eat up.
records.translation: Magandang umaga, @! Ipinaghanda kita ng masustansiyang almusal.[201]#$e#Magandang pinagmumulan ng mahahalagang sustansiya ang mga itlog, kaya kumain ka.

records.source: I'm going to study the medical literature today. It's important for me to keep up-to-date so I can give my patients the best care possible!
records.translation: Pag-aaralan ko ngayon ang mga babasahing medikal. Mahalagang manatili akong may pinakabagong kaalaman upang maibigay ko sa mga pasyente ko ang pinakamahusay na pangangalagang posible!

records.source: I'm going to listen to some jazz music and finalize my medical reports today. What do you have planned?
records.translation: Makikinig ako ng musikang jazz at tatapusin ang mga ulat medikal ko ngayon. Ano ang plano mo?

records.source: I was afraid of you when we first met. It's funny to think about now that we've come so far.$h
records.translation: Takot ako sa iyo noong una tayong nagkita. Nakakatawang isipin iyon ngayong napakalayo na ng narating natin.$h

records.source: You look exhausted, dear. Let me give you a massage tonight. I promise it will reduce the inflammation in your muscle tissue!$l
records.translation: Mukhang pagod na pagod ka, mahal. Hayaan mong imasahe kita ngayong gabi. Ipinapangako kong mababawasan nito ang pamamaga sa himaymay ng mga kalamnan mo!$l

records.source: I took it easy today... spent some time reading books, fiddled with my radio, and worked on a model airplane.#$e#It's important to take a day off now and then to relax... stress is unhealthy.
records.translation: Nagpahinga lang ako ngayon... nagbasa ng mga aklat, kinalikot ang radyo ko, at nag-ayos ng modelong eroplano.#$e#Mahalagang magpahinga paminsan-minsan... hindi mabuti sa kalusugan ang tensiyon.

records.source: Good evening... did you finish everything you needed to do today?#$e#Don't worry about me. I'm very self-sufficient. If you have more work to do go right ahead.
records.translation: Magandang gabi... natapos mo ba ang lahat ng kailangan mong gawin ngayon?#$e#Huwag kang mag-alala sa akin. Kayang-kaya kong alagaan ang sarili ko. Kung may kailangan ka pang gawin, ituloy mo lang.

records.source: It's stressful to be a doctor, so it's really great to live somewhere as relaxing as %farm Farm.
records.translation: Nagdudulot ng tensiyon ang pagiging doktor, kaya napakasarap tumira sa isang lugar na kasingpanatag ng Bukid na %farm.

records.source: Oh! I was just daydreaming about the circulatory system and forgot what I was trying to do. It's a classic doctor's problem.
records.translation: Ah! Nangangarap ako nang gising tungkol sa sistemang sirkulatoryo at nakalimutan ko ang sinusubukan kong gawin. Karaniwang problema iyan ng doktor.

records.source: This is a very safe spot. You go on ahead and take care of business, don't worry about me.
records.translation: Napakaligtas ng lugar na ito. Mauna ka na at asikasuhin ang mga gawain mo, huwag kang mag-alala sa akin.

records.source: I believe this must be the ideal place to raise children, scientifically. What do you think?
records.translation: Naniniwala akong ito ang perpektong lugar para magpalaki ng mga anak, batay sa agham. Ano sa tingin mo?

records.source: I may not be the most exciting guy, but I'll stay loyal to you for the rest of my life.$l
records.translation: Maaaring hindi ako ang pinakakapana-panabik na lalaki, pero mananatili akong tapat sa iyo habambuhay.$l

records.source: @... you... you mean the world to me.$l
records.translation: @... ikaw... ikaw ang mundo ko.$l

records.source: As a scientist I'm fascinated by the delicate interplay of insect and plant life.
records.translation: Bilang siyentipiko, nabibighani ako sa maselang ugnayan ng buhay ng mga insekto at halaman.

records.source: You and %kid1 are the most important parts of my life.
records.translation: Ikaw at si %kid1 ang pinakamahalagang bahagi ng buhay ko.

records.source: Little %kid1 is going to have the perfect childhood here. We're really fortunate to have this opportunity.
records.translation: Magkakaroon ng perpektong pagkabata rito ang munting si %kid1. Napakapalad nating magkaroon ng pagkakataong ito.

records.source: So far, I really like being a father!$h
records.translation: Hanggang ngayon, gustong-gusto ko talagang maging ama!$h

records.source: I already gave %kid1 and %kid2 their breakfasts. I'm trying to teach them to enjoy healthy food!
records.translation: Naibigay ko na kina %kid1 at %kid2 ang almusal nila. Sinisikap kong turuan silang masiyahan sa masustansiyang pagkain!

records.source: I believe a child should be allowed to play and explore to their heart's content. You're only a kid once.
records.translation: Naniniwala akong dapat hayaang maglaro at magsiyasat ang isang bata hangga’t gusto niya. Isang beses ka lang dadaan sa pagkabata.

records.source: Maybe %kid2 will grow up to become a pilot, like I never could?
records.translation: Baka maging piloto si %kid2 paglaki, isang pangarap na hindi ko natupad?

records.source: My life is devoted to you and the children now, and I'm very happy about it. I always dreamed of having a wonderful family.$l#$e#I had nightmares of being a bachelor forever.... I love you so much.$l
records.translation: Nakalaan na ngayon ang buhay ko sa iyo at sa mga bata, at napakasaya ko tungkol doon. Lagi kong pinangarap na magkaroon ng kahanga-hangang pamilya.$l#$e#Binabangungot akong baka manatili akong binata habambuhay.... Mahal na mahal kita.$l

records.source: @...I still can't believe we're married...$l
records.translation: @... Hindi pa rin ako makapaniwalang kasal na tayo...$l

records.source: You rescued me from a life of loneliness, and filled the emptiness in my heart. Thank you.$l
records.translation: Iniligtas mo ako mula sa malungkot na buhay at pinunô ang kahungkagan sa puso ko. Salamat.$l

records.source: I knew you were the one from the moment you moved here...$l
records.translation: Alam kong ikaw na ang para sa akin mula nang lumipat ka rito...$l

records.source: Wow, you look really handsome today! Did you shave?$l^Oh, my... you look beautiful today.$l
records.translation: Grabe, napakakisig mo ngayon! Nag-ahit ka ba?$l^Naku... napakaganda mo ngayon.$l

records.source: Be careful out there! I have nightmares about your limp body being wheeled into the emergency room.$7
records.translation: Mag-ingat ka roon! Binabangungot akong itinutulak papasok sa silid-emerhensiya ang nakahandusay mong katawan.$7

records.source: I think I'll take a little walk today. I need to unwind.
records.translation: Sa tingin ko ay maglalakad-lakad ako ngayon. Kailangan kong magpahinga.

records.source: I had a nice day. It's refreshing to spend some time alone now and then. Did you have a good day, honey?
records.translation: Naging maganda ang araw ko. Nakagiginhawang mapag-isa paminsan-minsan. Naging maganda ba ang araw mo, mahal?

records.source: It's wonderful to see all the plants return to life. The greenery is refreshing after a monochrome winter.
records.translation: Kahanga-hangang makitang muling nabubuhay ang lahat ng halaman. Nakagiginhawa ang luntiang kapaligiran matapos ang walang-kulay na taglamig.

records.source: Oh, it's a festival tomorrow, isn't it? Large crowds, activities... *gulp*$s
records.translation: Ah, may pista bukas, hindi ba? Maraming tao, mga gawain... *lagok*$s

records.source: W...Will you dance with me at the festival tomorrow?$7#$e#It's always a little embarrassing.$7
records.translation: M...Makikipagsayaw ka ba sa akin sa pista bukas?$7#$e#Lagi itong medyo nakakahiya.$7

records.source: Make sure you don't get sunburnt, dear! It's very dangerous for your skin.$8#$e#As your husband and doctor, I consider your health and safety my top priority!
records.translation: Tiyakin mong hindi ka masunog sa araw, mahal! Napakapanganib niyan para sa balat mo.$8#$e#Bilang asawa at doktor mo, itinuturing kong pinakamahalaga ang kalusugan at kaligtasan mo!

records.source: Have you thought about what you're going to put in the luau soup?#$e#I would put an item of high value and quality. We all want to leave a great impression on the governor!
records.translation: Naisip mo na ba kung ano ang ilalagay mo sa sopas ng Luau?#$e#Maglalagay ako ng bagay na mataas ang halaga at kalidad. Gusto nating lahat na mapahanga ang gobernador!

records.source: As summer draws to a close, and the colder season begins, my workload tends to increase. Sorry in advance if I'm a little moody...
records.translation: Habang nagtatapos ang tag-init at nagsisimula ang mas malamig na panahon, karaniwang dumarami ang trabaho ko. Paumanhin na agad kung medyo sumpungin ako...

records.source: Make sure and diversify your harvests this fall, my dear.#$e#Or just grow cranberries... It's really up to you. What do I know?
records.translation: Tiyaking sari-sari ang aanihin mo ngayong taglagas, mahal ko.#$e#O magtanim ka na lang ng mga cranberry... Ikaw talaga ang bahala. Ano ba ang alam ko?

records.source: Tomorrow's the fair. The food is very rich and salty, but I'm fine with splurging once in a while.$h
records.translation: Perya bukas. Napakabigat at maalat ng pagkain, pero ayos lang sa akin ang magpakasawa paminsan-minsan.$h

records.source: I'll admit, the spirit's eve festival usually gives me intestinal pain... but I'll do my best to be brave.
records.translation: Aaminin ko, karaniwang sumasakit ang mga bituka ko sa pista ng Bisperas ng mga Espiritu... pero gagawin ko ang lahat upang maging matapang.

records.source: The air is very dry during winter. That's why our skin tends to become irritated.#$e#Don't worry, I'll rub a little truffle oil onto your back every night.$l
records.translation: Napakatuyo ng hangin kapag taglamig. Iyon ang dahilan kung bakit madaling mairita ang balat natin.#$e#Huwag kang mag-alala, papahiran ko ng kaunting langis ng truffle ang likod mo gabi-gabi.$l

records.source: Are we going to stop by the ice festival tomorrow? I do enjoy the igloos...
records.translation: Dadaan ba tayo sa Pista ng Yelo bukas? Talagang nasisiyahan ako sa mga igloo...

records.source: Well, here's to a fantastic year. I have complete confidence that next year will be even better!$h
records.translation: Aba, para sa kamangha-manghang taong ito! Buo ang tiwala kong magiging mas maganda pa ang susunod na taon!$h
